inputs.text:
This is exactly the sort of political theatre that turns ordinary economic activity into a morality play. Gas companies help keep energy flowing, and property investment can give families a measure of security; demonising both is not reform. Angus Taylor was right not to change course just to appease critics.

And on Iran, caution is a sign of judgment, not weakness. Australia should make decisions about military force based on its own interests, not pressure to echo criticism of Donald Trump. Our leaders owe the public prudence and responsibility—not a rush to war.
